cases.invariant: A release needs at least one material evidence-backed claim.
Every cited source ID must exist in the source register.
A current claim cannot rely on stale supporting evidence.
A full package requires a valid PDF.
Public outputs cannot contain unresolved template markers.
Public outputs cannot expose local filesystem paths.
Placeholder URLs cannot become registered sources.
Secondary synthesis cannot be classified as primary Tier A evidence.
A full dossier cannot be downgraded to reduced output after render failure.
New factual paragraphs require Claim, source, and citation mapping.
Markdown or placeholder text cannot satisfy JSON contracts.
Receipt status cannot bypass digest and artifact hash verification.
Release requires matching package, registry, trust, and approval evidence.
